purpose: Test whether source-blind human surface attribution can distinguish geometry-v2 family overmerge from a genuine within-surface geometric conflict before any semantic relation graph is implemented.

cohort.selection_algorithm: Within each archive_name and declared label stratum, rank unique sample_id values by SHA-256 of the fixed seed, stratum and sample_id; take the first four. Geometry output is not available to selection.

blindness.packet_image: EXIF-oriented RGB decoded and re-saved as anonymous PNG without source metadata or original filename
blindness.posthoc_key_policy: The audit must not open the posthoc source key until all 36 annotations are frozen as completed or unassessable.
blindness.duplicate_visibility: Hidden duplicate identities and source groups are absent from blind packets and the blind manifest.
blindness.review_prohibition: The reviewer must not infer or record real, AI, generator or archive identity.

annotation_contract.first_step: Mark visible semantic surfaces such as facade, roof, road, floor, ceiling, repeated window or door array, railing, or another object surface.
annotation_contract.surface_geometry: Each surface has a normalized polygon and the detected line IDs that visibly belong to it.
annotation_contract.proposal_budget: At most four stable global families and four stable local families per packet. Families referenced by G1-G4 findings rank first by maximum finding severity; remaining controls rank by member count, bootstrap stability and inlier ratio. No source field participates.

critical_distinction.split_across_surfaces: The algorithm joined different visible surfaces because their image directions were similar. This is grouping error and never source evidence.
critical_distinction.geometry_inconsistent_within_surface: Lines assigned to one visible surface cannot satisfy the reviewed relation. This is only a candidate for later source-isolated study.

excluded_shortcuts: source label used as geometry truth

quality_gates.agreement_definition: Family agreement compares fixed proposal verdicts. Surface agreement compares whether common detected-line pairs were assigned to at least one shared surface and is invariant to surface names.

posthoc_reports: hidden duplicate family-verdict and surface line-pair agreement
algorithm overmerge prevalence kept separate from within-surface conflict prevalence
descriptive within-surface conflict and overmerge rates by declared label and archive with Wilson 95 percent intervals

decision_rules.quality_gate_failure: Revise annotation instructions or surface contract and repeat a new blinded pilot; do not inspect labels to tune geometry rules.
decision_rules.quality_gate_success: Permit only a larger blinded annotation round and a relation-graph implementation proposal.
decision_rules.source_signal_claim: Forbidden from this pilot regardless of posthoc rates.
